description: Owners only (needs sign-in): Only for a business an AI agent signed up itself with register_business, using the key it got from confirm_business_email: that agent is the owner, so it decides changes Latchbell held for the owner’s OK (approval_id from the held answer, or pending_approvals in front_desk). name: approve_own_change
